question: What further practice is prescribed to Maheśvarī involving eight hundred thousand repetitions?
premises: The mantra is chanted to the measure of eight hundred thousand.
The instruction is addressed to Maheśvarī.
This continues the graduated sequence of repetitions.
inference: The practitioner is instructed to chant the mantra eight hundred thousand times.
uncertainties: The specific attainment of this stage is stated in the following verse.
plain_english: And, O Maheśvarī, having chanted the mantra to the measure of eight hundred thousand times—
